reviews.comment: Participation matters significantly, but lecture was often reading off the textbook directly. Extremely difficult and not accomodating for those with testing accomodations, and even removed EC opportunities on my exams that the whole class got since I had to do dif times/locations. I didn't find that out until I saw another student's test.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: CSD was one of the most inspiring people I have ever had the pleasure to meet. She has an interesting background and is very easy to talk to. This class is heavy on readings and the tests can be a little difficult, but CSD almost always gives extra credit on her tests and even sprinkles some in throughout the year. Give her a shot!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Textbook heavy. Attendance required. Course is out of 420 points. 2 exams, 2 quizzes. Weekly assignments. No class on F. The tests are over 5 chapters, very specific questions. Decent amount of extra credit. Not very accessible outside of class. This professor is very nice, but wasn't the right teaching style for me. Ended with 88, rounded to an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Going to class was a waste bc she would read definitions from the textbook or lecture things completely unrelated to the curriculum. She only actually lectured us on 5 out of the 11 chapters covered in the course because she would talk ab her background all of class. She would give study hints for exams & exams would be nothing like what she said.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She never came to class prepared and read straight off the slide.

Inspiring background. Interested in helping students. You have to read. Creative in helping us learn course information. Thankful for extra credit. Her positive example made me become a sociology major!

The homework and quizzes are not too bad but the exams which are the bulk of the grade are very difficult requiring us to know of specific date or number of countries from one line in the entire reading (never spoken in lecture). And when it's not a random fact there are often multiple seeming correct answers. She's does give lots of extra credit.

Exams are hard and matter a lot,however she offers a LOT of extra credit I gained 19 extra credit that I know of not counting possible points i gained during the exam I might of gotten, thats out of the 420 in the total grade.There were many things that I didn't agree with her on and she did talk about her personal life but it was overall enjoyable
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Do not take her! Attendance is mandatory and instead of teaching the material she spends the entire class talking about her personal life. Her exams are difficult because she never once took class time to actually teach. She takes weeks to grade a single assignment. You must buy and read the textbook every day, and there is an assignment each week.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She reads directly off slides, only re stating what was written in the textbook chapter REQUIRED to read the weekend before. There are few tests and quizzes, and lots of writing assignments. She rambles a lot too, going into her private life a lot, her own opinions, and there were a couple days where she just spoke about herself! Easy but boring.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Going to lectures was pointless b/c she read word for word out of the textbook. It's hard to tell what will be on tests b/c her study guides say know every term from each chapter. No Friday class, lots of writing assignments, lots of textbook readings. She grades fairly, but too much work for an intro class. I like her as a person, not this class
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: This is her first year at A&M, so I added her on here to warn people against taking her as their professor. I cannot tell you enough to avoid her. She was extremely rude and misunderstanding. Her lectures were unhelpful, and her tests were hard. You will also be required to buy the textbook, and you will have to read it for class every week.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters
